messages.subject: Energy & Resources Executive | ESG, Government Relations & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Ally Search Team,

Your executive-search work across energy and resources, including oil and gas, power, renewables, metals and mining, is directly relevant to my international profile. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with leadership responsibilities spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where responsible development, institutional trust and complex stakeholder execution matter. I am internationally mobile, with Saudi Arabia and the UAE as priority markets.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
